title: Pure-Point Spectrum for the Two-Dimensional Anderson Model at Every Positive Disorder

issues.location: sections/transmission.tex, resonant.tex, impedance.tex (Prop trans:cell, imp:weighted, trans:envelope)
issues.description: Coverage note, not a demonstrated error. The comparison theorem (hier:comparison) depends on three cell-level inputs: the transmission lower bound E|t|^2 >= e^{-C(log L)^2} E_B rho, the relative cutoff estimate E[|mu||t|^2] <= e^{-cL} E|t|^2, and the interior envelope used in the parent-alternative cap. These are long polynomial-degree and determinant-phase arguments that I did not check line by line. Everything downstream (almost-monotone d_n, the d=0 contradiction, the bootstrap) takes them as black boxes. Any gap would most likely be here, especially the uniformity over unbounded passive exterior data T and k.
issues.evidence: trans:cell: 'uniformly in the fixed exterior data and allowed corner boxes, E|t|^2 >= e^{-C(log L)^2} E_B rho, E[|mu||t|^2] <= e^{-cL} E|t|^2'

coverage:
I read the whole of introduction, setup, spectral (Sec 11), bootstrap (Sec 10), vanishing (Sec 9), hierarchy (Sec 7), matrix (Sec 3) and screening (Sec 8). I only skimmed resonant (Sec 4) and the start of transmission (Sec 5). I did not read impedance (Sec 6) or the rest of transmission in detail.

What I checked:
- Numerically confirmed the common-phase closure formula S_z = A + Tz(1-zB)^{-1}T^T and the exact single-port energy identity Q_{S_z} - Q_S = -2Re(gamma u^T F A^* F u) - |gamma|^2 (u^*Fu)^2.
- Checked the trace and Dirichlet-energy algebra, including the first-variation expansion with the M0^{-4} normalisation, and the internal-positive decomposition behind the central value h(0).
- Checked the logarithmic capacity bound C/log M0, the joint-density L^2 bound for the bounded twist, and the Hoelder plus subharmonicity contradiction, including the order of quantifiers.
- Bootstrap: the mixture-domination half-interval argument with Cauchy mass about c/C0, the tilted L2-L1 one-site bound, the barrier iteration giving 2^{-cC0}, the unconditional resampling factorisation, the contraction over masks, and the 2x2 endpoint identity G_xy = S_xy det(1 - i tau g)/(2i tau).
- The rank-one spectral averaging and readout with Fubini, and the hierarchy interpolation cost (log K_l polynomial in b_l against e^{-cL_l}) and charge tails.
main_claim: For each fixed h>0, the 2D Anderson operator with iid Uniform[-h,h] potentials almost surely has pure-point spectrum, a complete eigenbasis, and spectrum [-4-h,4+h]. The route is: a hierarchy of rare resonant 'port' cells; a Cauchy-closure energy supermartingale; a limiting affine energy d forced to 0 by 2D capacity and a subharmonicity contradiction; a fractional-moment bootstrap for the torus Green function; and Simon-Wolff rank-one averaging.
sibling_notes: The family 261 board held one entry, rank 85 (the weak-disorder absolutely-continuous spectrum paper in d>=3), marked no_gap_found with partial coverage. It shares no lemmas with this paper, so it did not affect this audit. I posted this paper's summary to the board.
